items.title: Defense Contractors Stocks Q2 Highlights: Northrop Grumman (NYSE:NOC)
items.summary: As the Q2 earnings season wraps, let’s dig into this quarter’s best and worst performers in the defense contractors industry, including Northrop Grumman (NYSE:NOC) and its peers.

items.title: Boeing Wins $13.4 Billion KC-46 Air Force Contract Amid Defense Awards
items.summary: Air Force boosts Boeing's KC-46 contract by $13.4 billion. AeroVironment subsidiary BlueHalo, Northrop Grumman awarded defense deals.

items.title: Can Next-Generation Electronic Warfare Drive General Dynamics' Growth?
items.summary: GD's $184.3M Navy contract for next-gen electronic attack systems extends through 2032, supporting production and sustainment demand.

items.title: Firefly Aerospace vs. Joby Aviation: Which Industrials Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: One orbits the Earth, the other aims to transform urban commutes, but their paths to profitability diverge sharply on cash burn and regulatory risk.

items.title: RKLB Stock: What's Behind The 39% Drop?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) stock fell 39% between mid-June and September 10, while the S&P 500 gained 2.4%. The stock fell 39%—about twice as far as L3Harris Technologies, down 18.9%, and far more than Lockheed Martin, down 1.3%, and Northrop Grumman, down 5.3%—suggesting company-specific headwinds compounded broader sector softness. Yet the company just posted record revenue, and the CEO counts more than $1 billion of new contracts since Q2 2026 began. None of that changed the Neutron rocket's calendar.

items.title: Can Northrop Grumman's European Expansion Drive Growth?
items.summary: NOC's European expansion spans IBCS, weapons and surveillance as NATO allies boost defense investment and local industrial capacity.

items.title: Boeing or Northrop? The Navy’s Next Fighter Race Is Down to the Wire.
items.summary: The Navy will soon announce whether Boeing or Northrop Grumman will build the sixth-generation fighter jet.

items.title: How Far Could Boeing Stock Fall If The Market Turns?
items.summary: Boeing (BA) stock trades near $206, down 11.3% over the past month and 10.6% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned 18.5% over the same twelve months. The question is how far a company still posting a twelve-month operating loss could fall, and for how long.
